theorems.name: Submission.p05_pie_minor_product_containment_a5b449214a
theorems.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι κ ν : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype ν] (A : Matrix ι κ R) (B : Matrix κ ν R) (d : ℕ), (Ideal.span {x : R | ∃ (rows : Fin d ↪ ι) (cols : Fin d ↪ ν), x = Matrix.det ((A * B).submatrix rows cols)}) ≤ (Ideal.span {x : R | ∃ (rows : Fin d ↪ ι) (cols : Fin d ↪ κ), x = Matrix.det (A.submatrix rows cols)}) ⊓ (Ideal.span {x : R | ∃ (rows : Fin d ↪ κ) (cols : Fin d ↪ ν), x = Matrix.det (B.submatrix rows cols)})
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
